# Senato fixtures

Minimal, attributed SPARQL JSON result extracts modelled on the official Senato
ontology (`http://dati.senato.it/osr/`). They cover XIX Legislature people,
mandates, group-affiliation intervals, patrimonial links, and an electronic
plenary roll call. Values and predicates are preserved exactly so adapter tests
exercise the same contract as verified source artifacts without network access.

Source documentation: https://dati.senato.it/sito/21
